cohort: Preterm neonates born at Hyogo Prefectural Amagasaki General Medical Center between January 2018 and December 2023 were included.
finding: Caffeine therapy was associated with decreased severe ROP in neonates with gestational age between 23 and 28 weeks.
birth_weight: Collected; a subgroup of <1500 g was analyzed.
gest_age: Preterm neonates; primary finding focused on those between 23 and 28 weeks.
